warnings: VLM notes: 1. The diagram shows heat exchanger E-234-009 as a vendor package (dashed boundary, NOTE 7) containing two fan/blower motors (2901A left, 2901B right) with vibration protection, two manual control stations (HIC-2903A/B with HY relays and pneumatic control valves), and shell-and-tube or plate-frame exchanger body with hatch marks. 2. RS symbols on 8-inch lines appear to be spectacle blinds or rated isolation valve assemblies — exact valve type slightly ambiguous at this resolution. 3. The TY-2911 circle at top receives a dashed signal line from TT-2917 (top right) spanning the full width — this is a temperature computing relay feeding TIC-2911 for cascade or feedforward temperature control. 4. F3D and CD3D labels on right side likely represent utility connections (possibly cooling duty CD3D = cooling duty, F3D = fire water or flush duty). 5. P-234-03304-CD3D-1-N is an off-page pipe connector (bottom right, NOTE 12). 6. KV-2904 appears to be a solenoid or automated valve on a 1-inch auxiliary/drain line, NOTE 8. 7. NOTES 4 and 10 reference field-mounted start/stop and emergency stop pushbuttons (circle HS symbols) for both motors A and B — these are hard-wired safety circuits. 8. The MCC blocks for 2901A and 2901B show cross-connected signals indicating motor interchange/duty-standby interlock capability. 9. TG-2910 and TG-2912 are local temperature gauges (glasses). 10. The H flag on TIC-2911 indicates a high temperature alarm is configured on that controller. 11. SEQ triangles feed permissive signals to STOP/START hand switches — a sequence logic interlock prevents starting without permissive conditions being met. 12. Image resolution limits confident identification of all small valve symbols in the inlet/outlet headers.
Extraction confidence (0.78) below threshold (0.85). Consider DEXPI input for validation.

fmea_records.detection_method: Stroke mismatch between handle and flow
fmea_records.recommended_action: Isolate upstream; remove valve for rebuild

fmea_records.failure_effect_local: Gate valve stem seized by corrosion
fmea_records.recommended_action: Apply penetrating fluid; if seized, replace valve

fmea_records.failure_effect_system: Process fluid contaminates utility stream (or vice versa)
fmea_records.detection_method: Conductivity analyser on cooling water return; AT alarm
fmea_records.recommended_action: Isolate and plug affected tubes; schedule re-tube at shutdown

fmea_records.detection_method: TI outlet temperature trending; increasing DP
fmea_records.recommended_action: Chemical clean or mechanical descale per maintenance schedule

fmea_records.failure_effect_system: Flooded condenser; reflux loss; column upset
fmea_records.recommended_action: Purge non-condensables; check vent valve operation

fmea_records.failure_effect_system: High-pressure side overfills low-pressure side; PSV demand
fmea_records.detection_method: PSV on low-pressure side; DP-loss alarm
fmea_records.recommended_action: Activate ESD; isolate both sides; investigate per API 521

fault_diagnosis.repair_procedure:
PRIORITY REPAIR ACTIONS (Critical fault modes):
Reference: IEC 61511:2016+AMD1 Clause 5.2 — Functional Safety Management

  [TI-2909] LOW
    Effect  : Heating ramp-up — risk of overtemperature
    Detect  : NAMUR NE 107 Failure alarm
    Action  : Check wire continuity; replace sensor element

  [PSD-2917] FAIL_TO_OPERATE
    Effect  : Safety function fails dangerously — hazard not detected
    Detect  : SIL proof-test; PFDavg calculation
    Action  : Immediate proof-test; replace if failed; review SIL maintenance schedule

SAFETY INSTRUMENTED FUNCTION MAINTENANCE:
  Per IEC 61511-1:2016 Clause 16 (Proof testing):
  — Loop 2917-SAFETY: Verify sensor TT-2917, logic, and actuator PSD-2917 / TI-2917-HH (trip H-234-001) per SIL proof-test schedule.
  — Loop 2901A: Verify sensor VSHH-2901A, logic, and actuator Motor-2901A (fan/pump A) per SIL proof-test schedule.
  — Loop 2901B: Verify sensor VSHH-2901B, logic, and actuator Motor-2901B (fan/pump B) per SIL proof-test schedule.
  — Loop 3200: Verify sensor ESD-3200, logic, and actuator MCC-2901A / MCC-2901B (motor trip) per SIL proof-test schedule.
